subject.title: fix(sqlite): avoid mutating invalid databases during repair

question: Should doctor and maintenance continue to fail closed for a current-schema database missing required tables, preserving it for recovery rather than rebuilding missing tables during repair?
rationale: This changes the operator-facing recovery contract for damaged persisted state; the repository policy favors canonical runtime shapes and doctor-owned migrations, but a maintainer should explicitly confirm this strict recovery boundary before merge.

options.title: Keep fail-closed repair
options.body: Reject malformed current-schema databases atomically while preserving the recognized legacy migration path and actionable doctor warnings.

options.title: Allow reconstruction during doctor repair
options.body: Permit doctor to recreate missing current-schema tables, accepting that a damaged database may be partially normalized before a later failure.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed repair
recommendation.body: Reject malformed current-schema databases atomically while preserving the recognized legacy migration path and actionable doctor warnings.
